label: R20-FINAL-PACK-CUT
scope: 在 scalar FP_ITER 私有 FSM 中为 ordinary pack_mid 与 iterative DIV/SQRT finish 的最终 result/flags/done 增加统一 IT_PACK_RESULT 寄存边界；不改变公共接口和前级路由。

implementation.summary: IT_PACK executes round_pack_p2 into private fp_calc_t result registers and enters IT_PACK_RESULT; only the latter exposes registered result/flags and a one-cycle iter_done window.

state_semantics.IT_PACK: valid=1: p2 ordinary pack_mid or iterative it_fin_mid is captured and state advances; valid=0: transaction is discarded with no done.
state_semantics.IT_PACK_RESULT: valid=1 and !pause: registered result/flags are visible and iter_done is asserted for one sampling interval; next edge returns IDLE and clears valid marker.
state_semantics.pause: state and result payload hold; output result/flags remain stable while iter_done=0.
state_semantics.valid_drop: IT_PACK/IT_PACK_RESULT drops return IDLE and prevent stale result commit; final-window drop also cancels while paused.
state_semantics.kill_reset: higher priority than pause; state and all final result registers clear to zero.

implementation.architectural_commit: unchanged; wrapper slot capture remains the sole architectural consumer

latency.delta_rule: exactly +1 cycle per shared scalar slot that reaches final round-pack; NEON transaction delta is +slot_count

coverage: S/D/H iterative DIV/SQRT finish and special/inexact flags
registered result source and exactly-once done
